10.  Article  38  is  hereby  amended  by  the  repeal  and
replacement of paragraph (2) of that Article as follows:-
“(2) The office of President shall become vacant upon
Parliament passing, by not less than one half of the
whole number of Members of Parliament (including
those not present), voting in its favour, a resolution
of  no-  confidence  against  the  President,  which
resolution  may  be  introduced  by  a  written  notice
addressed to the Speaker, signed by not less  than
one  third  of  the  whole  number  of  Members  of
Parliament.”.

(a) By the deletion of the words “Prime Minister” and
the substitution therefor of the words “Speaker” in
paragraph (2) thereof;
(b) By the deletion of the words “and shall appoint one
of  the  other Ministers of the Cabinet to act in the
office  of  the  Prime  Minister”  in  paragraph  (2)
